invariant: ADR-0155 D-0, O2 (ruling A carried to Oracle): where the outer column is a RAW(16) uuid column by the catalog prime the list's HEXTORAW(?) binding reads (`oracleRawUuidFieldsByObject`, same object and field), the fixed-read leaf's inner read projects `oracleUuidRawProjection`, HEXTORAW(REPLACE(record_id, '-', '')), so each grant is the same 16 bytes the list binds for the same uuid text and the leaf answers the list's rows. Without it Oracle compares the RAW column as its upper-case hex text and the leaf silently answers no row (its negation every row). Any other Oracle key keeps step 3's statement. A grant the list refuses before SQL has no refusal here (not hex: ORA-01465, DATABASE_ERROR / 500; hex of another length: names no row).
